1.w: My child, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

2.w: for they will provide a long and full life and well-being for you.

3.w: Do not let mercy and truth leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.

4.w: Then you will find favor and good understanding in the sight of God and people.

5.w: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not rely on your own understanding.

6.w: Acknowledge him in all your ways, and he will make your paths straight.

7.w: Do not be wise in your own estimation; fear the Lord and turn away from evil.

8.w: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your inner self.

9.w: Honor the Lord from your wealth and from the firstfruits of all your crops;

10.w: then your barns will be filled completely, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

11.w: My child, do not despise discipline from the Lord , and do not loathe his rebuke.

12.w: For the Lord disciplines those he loves, just as a father disciplines the son in whom he delights.

13.w: Blessed is the one who has found wisdom and the one who obtains understanding.

14.w: For her benefit is more profitable than silver, and her gain is better than gold.

15.w: She is more precious than rubies, and none of the things you desire can compare with her.

16.w: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.

17.w: Her ways are very pleasant, and all her paths are peaceful.

18.w: She is like a tree of life to those who grasp onto her, and everyone who takes hold of her will be blessed.

19.w: By wisdom the Lord laid the foundation of the earth; he established the heavens by understanding.

20.w: By his knowledge the primordial sea was broken open, so that the clouds drip down dew.

21.w: My child, do not let them escape from your sight; safeguard sound wisdom and discretion.

22.w: So they will become life for your soul and grace around your neck.

23.w: Then you will walk on your way with security, and you will not stumble.

24.w: When you lie down you will not be filled with fear; when you lie down your sleep will be pleasant.

25.w: Do not be afraid of sudden disaster or when destruction overtakes the wicked;

26.w: for the Lord will be the source of your confidence, and he will guard your foot from being caught in a trap.

27.w: Do not withhold good from those who need it when you have the ability to help.

28.w: Do not say to your neighbor, “Go! Return tomorrow and I will give it,” when you have it with you at the time.

29.w: Do not plot evil against your neighbor when he dwells by you unsuspectingly.

30.w: Do not accuse anyone without legitimate cause if he has not treated you wrongly.

31.w: Do not envy a violent man, and do not choose any of his ways;

32.w: for one who goes astray is an abomination to the Lord , but he reveals his intimate counsel to the upright.

33.w: The Lord ’s curse is on the household of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.

34.w: With arrogant scoffers he is scornful, yet he shows favor to the humble.

35.w: The wise inherit honor, but he holds fools up to public contempt.
